🎥🎬: How to Be a Latin Lover (2017)

Maximo is a charming professional gigolo who has spent his entire adult life living a luxurious lifestyle by dating wealthy older women. After 25 years of enjoying expensive cars, designer clothes and lavish vacations, his comfortable world comes crashing down when his much older wife suddenly dumps him for a younger man.

With nowhere to go and no money to support his extravagant habits, Maximo is forced to move in with his estranged sister Sara and her young son, Hugo. Determined to return to his former lifestyle, he begins plotting his way into the life of a wealthy widow while attempting to teach his nephew the secrets of winning over women.

However, as Maximo’s schemes become increasingly ridiculous, he begins discovering that genuine love, family and responsibility may be worth more than the luxurious lifestyle he has spent years chasing.

source_details.synopsis: How to Be a Latin Lover is a 2017 American comedy film starring Eugenio Derbez, Salma Hayek, Raphael Alejandro, Raquel Welch, Rob Riggle, Rob Huebel, Rob Corddry, Renée Taylor, Linda Lavin, Kristen Bell, and Rob Lowe. This was also Welch's final film before she died in 2023. The film was directed by Ken Marino and written by Chris Spain and Jon Zack. The film follows a man who has spent his whole life married to a rich old woman, and must learn to make it on his own when she kicks him out. It was released on April 28, 2017 by Pantelion Films and grossed $62.6 million worldwide.
